purpose: Register public market references and enterprise execution-price controls for ammonia dispatch.

sources.name: National Bureau of Statistics - production materials
Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange
sources.refresh: intraday or end-of-day, subject to market-data authorization
sources.note: Futures price is not liquid-ammonia spot price or enterprise landed price.

sources.name: MOFCOM commodity price network
sources.refresh: periodic industry publication; not a continuous real-time feed
sources.note: Keep the original article and publication date because public entries may be averages or ranges.

sources.name: Yuntu ERP / sales and procurement settlement
sources.refresh: order change, quotation confirmation, or daily settlement

fallback_policy.unconfirmed_update: Do not enter an executable plan; keep the last valid price version.
fallback_policy.missing_primary_price: Keep public reference cards visible, freeze liquid-ammonia execution price and economic ranking, and route to business confirmation.
